visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A muscular man in a black short-sleeved athletic shirt and black shorts runs along a paved path in a sun-drenched park. The sun shines brightly through the pine trees, creating significant lens flares. He begins running towards the camera before turning away into the distance. A lake is partially visible in the background through the trees. A woman stands in the distance on the right, holding a phone to capture a photo. (2) The scene cuts to the same man running on an athletic track during a marathon event. He is now wearing a blue tank top, a black cap, and a sports watch. He is surrounded by other runners and the environment is a large stadium with urban buildings and event banners in the background. As he runs, he looks focused, eventually crossing a line and throwing his hands up in a celebratory gesture, shouting with high-arousal facial expressions.

visual_scene_and_style.backgroundDescribe: The first location is a serene park with tall pine trees, a paved path, and a lake under bright sunlight. The second location is a professional athletic track in a city, featuring blue running lanes, event arches, and high-rise buildings in the distance.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) High-energy hip-hop music starts with a driving trap beat and synthesizer melody. No vocals are present initially. The sound of rhythmic breathing or footsteps is faintly buried in the mix. (2) A sharp, classic record scratch sound effect marks a transition. (3) Male rap vocals enter, delivering rhythmic lines in English with high arousal and a confident tone. Background ambient crowd cheering and applause fade in, suggesting a public event. The main character lets out a triumphant shout at the end, overlapping with the music and crowd noise as the track reaches a climax.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To showcase the athlete's significant improvement in running performance throughout the year 2025, culminating in successful marathon completion times. It uses a popular comparison format to inspire and demonstrate personal growth.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: The runner is prominently wearing Shokz bone conduction headphones and participating in the Taipei Marathon, which is heavily branded by Fubon Financial.
